subject: MedNova: bespoke VPC tiering + graduated discount request
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@mednova.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mednova.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bespoke VPC tiering and graduated discount (MedNova RFP attached)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked what we saw. Our procurement lead asked me to follow up with a concrete ask so Finance can evaluate models side-by-side. The RFP (attached) outlines expected usage: roughly 600M tokens/month year 1, growing to ~1.2B tokens/month by year 3, and a mix of hosted embeddings and private VPC inference for PHI-bound traffic.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood provide a graduated discount schedule tied to committed token volume across a 3-year contract?
- We need clarity on how the platform fee for Private (VPC) gets amortized — can it be spread across the term or applied as an upfront entitle?
- How do support tiers map to response targets for on-prem incidents (RTO, on-call escalation cadence)?
- Any standard exit protections / data handoff assistance we should expect for on-prem?

Please see the RFP attached (MedNova_RFP_v2.pdf). Can your team send an initial commercial construct and any assumptions by Monday?

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Director, Procurement — MedNova Health
procurement@mednova.com

Attachment: MedNova_RFP_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@mednova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke VPC tiering and graduated discount (MedNova RFP attached)

Hi Alice — thanks for the detail and the RFP. Looping Marissa (commercial lead) and Ben (solutions) so we can put together a concrete proposal. A few quick clarifying Qs before we prepare the graduated schedule:

1) For the 3-year commitment, do you expect a single commitment covering both hosted and VPC, or will the VPC (PII/PHI) traffic be covered under a separate commit?
2) For year-over-year growth, is the 1.2B token forecast firm (we can build tiers against it) or an aspirational cap?
3) Any constraints on upfront capital vs. amortized platform fee from a procurement accounting perspective? If you prefer amortization, we can show both upfront and amortized illustrations.

We'll draft a graduated discount ladder (example: 0–400M, 400–800M, 800M+) with platform fee treatment variants and a mapping to our Support Tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with on-call response SLAs. Expect a first-pass commercial memo and an attachment (Redwood_Tiering_Proposal_v1.xlsx) by Monday EOD.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Tiering_Proposal_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx, stub)

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@mednova.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Turner <alice.turner@mednova.com>, legal@mednova.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke VPC tiering and graduated discount (MedNova RFP attached)

Evelyn / Marissa — quick clarifications from Procurement/Legal: 

• The intent is a single commercial agreement covering both hosted and VPC, but with clear segregation of PHI-bound workloads (we'd like platform fee to reflect the private deployment premium).
• For accounting we prefer amortized platform fee over 36 months; an upfront entitle complicates CapEx. Can you show an amortized schedule with annual true-up?
• Support: Gold tier must include a named SRE escalation path and a 4-hour P1 response window for critical on-prem incidents during business hours (we can accept extended hours for on-call at premium).
• Exit / data handoff: we need a defined end-of-term handover plan and optionally a short migration assistance credit if we transition away.

If you can include those items in the commercial memo Monday, Procurement will review and route to Legal for redlines.

Thanks,
Rajesh Patel
Senior Manager, Procurement — MedNova Health
procurement@mednova.com

Cc: legal@mednova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@mednova.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@mednova.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke VPC tiering and graduated discount (MedNova RFP attached)

Hi Alice / Rajesh,

Appreciate the clarifications — attached is our first-pass commercial construct and the support SLA pack (SLA-SupportTiers-2027.pdf). Highlights below (summary):

- Graduated volume ladder (3-year term, annual true-ups):
  • Tier A (0–400M monthly): base list pricing
  • Tier B (400–800M monthly): 9% discount off list
  • Tier C (800M+ monthly): 14% discount off list
  (We will show blended effective rate in the attachment based on your forecasted ramp.)

- Platform fee: two illustrations included
  • Option 1 — Upfront entitle (one-time) for on-prem VPC premium
  • Option 2 — 36-month amortization with annual reconciliation and pro-rata true-up (preferred for your accounting ask)

- Support: Gold tier (recommended) includes named SRE escalation, 4-hour P1 response during business hours, 24x7 P1 with on-call add-on, and quarterly runbooks/DR run-throughs. Full escalation ladder in SLA doc.

- Exit protections: we propose a 60-day migration assistance credit (25% of one month’s platform fee) plus documented handoff checklist and export package (logs, configs, model pins). We can extend to a 90-day assisted migration for an added fee; details in the proposal.

Attachments: Redwood_Tiering_Proposal_v1.xlsx, SLA-SupportTiers-2027.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DN-2027-0173

Next steps: if this construct looks directionally correct, we'll work with Legal to prepare a redlineable draft and propose a commercial walk-through with your team on Thursday. Any immediate hard stops from Procurement?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Commercials — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Redwood_Tiering_Proposal_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx), SLA-SupportTiers-2027.pdf (application/pdf)
